arabic text: ABBASE AMMU JAANAM MAN AAB NAMI KHAHAM\nSAQQAE SHAHIDAANAM MAN AAB NAMI KHAAHAM
english translation text: O ABBAS MY BELOVED UNCLE, I DO NOT WANT WATER (ANYMORE)\nO THE QUENCHER OF THIRST, MY MARTYR, I DO NOT WANT WATER (ANYMORE)

arabic text: BAR GARD E AMU JANAM, AZ HIJR E TU BIMARAM\nAY NOORE DO CHASH MANAM, MAN AAB NAMI KHAAHAM
english translation text: COME BACK MY DEAR UNCLE, I'M UNWELL BECAUSE OF MISSING YOU\nOH APPLE OF MY EYES, I DON'T WANT WATER (ANYMORE)

arabic text: AY AM-E JAWANE MAN, AY RUH E RAWAN E MAN\nDARD E TU BE HAAL E MAN, MAN AAB NAMI KHAAHAM
english translation text: OH MY YOUNG UNCLE, OH MY SPIRIT AND MY SOUL\nMAY YOUR CALAMITIES BE MINE, I DON'T WANT WATER (ANYMORE)

arabic text: ABBASE ALAMDARAM, SAQQAE YATEEMANAM\nBE MOONISO BE YAARAM, MAN AAB NAMI KHAAHAM
english translation text: OH MY FLAG BEARER ABBAS, QUENCHER OF THIRST OF MY ORPHANS\nI HAVE NO COMPANION AND NO HELPER, I DON'T WANT WATER (ANYMORE)
